purpose: Check open provider admission, actual shard execution, funded native settlement and epoch recovery before an LLM deployment allocation.
model: Deterministic five-partition CPU fixture; no training or quality claim
pass: Unlisted provider keys restore only their committed partitions and acknowledge native assignments
All five owners agree on each response and assignment-bound signature
Three complete numerical replays reproduce each native inference claim
Both killed owners are replaced by fresh keys and endpoints through native transactions
Each replacement preserves its request and graph, changes the epoch, and settles exactly once
All four validators agree on the result, fees and refunds; inference issues no tokens
All trial processes stop at completion or the declared deadline
limits: One administrator and one physical host. This does not satisfy the independent-operator soak or measure the accepted LLM's latency or costs.
